source: Ed4 C.7.2 (f) to (j) and (o), pp.C-98 to C-99; C.5.1, pp.C-57 to C-58
description: With dts.max_window 2, a three-segment ARQ C_PDU sends two D_PDUs and waits, without contending, until the acknowledgement moves TX LWE; then the third goes.
note: Link setup as cas/make-caller-accepted: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call the peer (Ed4 request out at 75000, sent at 80550), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link with the 16-bit family (B-0219, B-0142): window edges TX LWE 0, TX UWE 65535, RX LWE 0, RX UWE 65535 (C-0782, C-0787). The held U_PDU goes down as an ARQ C_PDU (A-0194) and dts.ttd runs to its TTD (C-1050). The burst ends at 92000 with the EOT prediction at 96000 ahead and data queued: csma.vdcd_end; at 96000 LBT rule 1 (the burst was addressed only to us, K-0067) and contention, 12000 ms (second draw). The U_PDU is the 12 bytes 'twelve bytes', so the C_PDU is 18 bytes, cut at its first placement into three 6-byte segments (dts.max_segment_size 6, C-0503, C-0507, C-0509). At 108000 FSNs 0 and 1 are placed (C-0510); the window is then 2, the maximum allowable (dts.max_window, C-0770, C-0772 to C-0775, C-0785), so the third segment waits, and since its C_PDU has already started nothing else may be placed after it (C-0850, C-1127). FSN 0 has C_PDU START and TX WIN LWE, FSN 1 TX WIN UWE (C-0185, C-0186, C-1122); 25 bytes each, one block each, EOTs 20 and 10. At 118350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts; nothing else can be placed (K-0096), so the MAC stays in SENSE and contends for nothing. At 126000 the ACK-ONLY carries RX LWE 2: FSNs 0 and 1 are acknowledged, TX LWE becomes 2 (C-0780, C-0781), dts.ack_wait stops and the window is open again (C-0775). The burst ends at 127000: csma.vdcd_end to 131000, LBT rule 1, contention 45000 ms (third draw). At 176000 FSN 2 goes with C_PDU END, and with both TX WIN flags, being both edges now. At 181550 dts.ack_wait starts; at 191000 RX LWE 3 acknowledges it: dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed (C-0679, C-1130) and dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): no transmission here has room in its last block for a copy of its ACK-ONLY (15 or more bytes) or for a PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes), so each is zero filled.
